answer_1.quote: this study introduces Synth-SBDH, a novel synthetic SBDH dataset that mimics EHR notes. ... generated and annotated by an LLM (GPT-4) with detailed SBDH information
answer_1.outputs: synthetic EHR notes with SBDH annotations including presence, temporality, and rationale
